name: Morning Fun
source:
Morning Fun is a free adult Visual Novel of a demon gilf, Lither, in which she is  a Succubus in a failed and sad marriage, something that can be very frustrating for a lust demon.

Lither believes she has been cultivating feelings for another demon lady, and finds herself thinking about her after a cult gathering.

In this mini game you'll find out that Lither isn't too old to have fun!

[from [url=https://lemonnleaf.itch.io/morning-fun]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Morning Fun》是一部免费的成人视觉小说，讲述了恶魔吉尔莉瑟 (Lither) 的故事，她是一位处于失败而悲伤婚姻中的魅魔，这对于欲望恶魔来说是非常令人沮丧的。

利瑟相信她一直在与另一位恶魔女士培养感情，并发现自己在一次邪教聚会后想起了她。

在这个游戏中，你会发现Lither的年龄并不算太大，不能玩得开心！

[来自[url=https://lemonnleaf.itch.io/morning-fun]itch.io[/url]]
